editions.title: Last week in motorsport
editions.intro: Five rounds across the Clio Cup Series, NASCAR Cup Series, IMSA SportsCar Championship, MotoGP and NHRA Drag Racing took place between 14 and 20 September.

items.headline: Bass Pro Shops Night Race
items.body: The NASCAR Cup Series round 29, the Bass Pro Shops Night Race, took place at Bristol Motor Speedway on Sat 19 Sep.

items.headline: Battle on the Bricks
items.body: Round 10 of the IMSA SportsCar Championship, the Battle on the Bricks, was held at Indianapolis Motor Speedway on Sun 20 Sep.

items.headline: Grand Prix of Austria
items.detail: Red Bull Ring - Spielberg, Austria · Sun 20 Sep
items.body: Pedro Acosta of Red Bull KTM Factory Racing won the Grand Prix of Austria, ahead of Jorge Martin and Marco Bezzecchi for Aprilia Racing.
